docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $250.18 FILED BY BENCHARGE CREDIT SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT GUZMAN ISABELL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-24-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 05
